name: Kousuke
source:
A 2nd-year student at Hanazono High School, he is an ordinary 17-year-old boy with a typical interest in the opposite sex for his age. 

One day, while living alone in an apartment after leaving his parents' house, he learns about Makie's murder and Himeka's true identity, leading him to cooperate with her.
